fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS integrity protection with EEA4 ciphering enforcement via RRC/NAS rules.
Set NAS sequence number thresholds (e.g., reject >1000 consecutive increments).
Enable 5G NAS replay attack detection with 3-second timestamp validation.
Block nested EEA4 parameters unless from trusted MME/SMF via NAS rules.
Implement NAS message rate limiting (e.g., <5 messages/second per UE).
Enforce NAS security mode completion (SMC) before data transmission.
Deploy IMSI-catcher detection via NAS EMM cause code (e.g., reject cause 503).
Update RAN to filter NAS messages with gsm_a_common_elem_id=11 (legacy IMSI trap).
Enable NAS trace logging for all EEA4 ciphering failures with NAS-eps_seq_no.
Monitor NAS-eps_emm_eea4_show anomalies via automated KPI alerts.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
